name: plugin_dedup

configurable_fields.variant_fields: Fields to check for variant detection (default: ['color','size','pack'])
configurable_fields.variant_title_threshold: Title similarity threshold for variant detection (default: 0.8)
configurable_fields.field_mapping: Dict mapping actual CSV column names to match_field names (e.g. {'walmart_title': 'title'})
configurable_fields.pairs_output_path: Optional path to write duplicate pair details as CSV
configurable_fields.output_path: Override output file path (auto-generated if omitted)

description: Universal deduplication plugin - find duplicates based on configurable fields
